AI Video Simple 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Simplify raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and export cleaned 1080p MP4 files in seconds.

- Supports video upload, audio/text overlays, silence trimming, and fast export workflows.
